```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L1/103_extract_ETF_EPT_annotations.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
L1_data_dir <- here("data", "L1") # L1 data
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data
label_data <- read_csv(here(L1_data_dir, "102_ETF_EPT_image_labels.csv"))

# save a raw version backup
#saveRDS(label_data, file = here(L1_data_dir, "102_ETF_EPT_image_labels.rds"))
```

# Process data

```{r}
#| label: parse-notes
# List of standard labels used for annotating images
standard_labels <- c(
  "light trap",
  "preserved",
  "corrected",
  "predation",
  "flower",
  "fave",
  "dupe",
  "mating",
  "eggs",
  "egg",
  "no image",
  "fungus",
  "unsure",
  "copyright"
)

# Parse strings from the `notes` column
# Strings may be like `light trap` or `other species - {SPECIES NAME}`, separted by a space & semicolon
labels_regex <- paste(standard_labels, collapse = "|")

parsed_data <- label_data |>
  # Remoe metadata associated with images
  select(-image_path, -filename, -image_id, -obs_total, -obs_pos) |>
  distinct(observation_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    # Extract species names
    # (?<=other species - ) looks behind for the exact phrase
    # [^;]+ grabs everything after that phrase UNTIL it hits a semicolon or the end of the string
    species_id_corrected = str_extract(notes, "(?<=other species - )[^;]+") |>
      str_trim(),
    # Find unmatched notes
    odd_cases = notes |>
      # Delete the "other species" phrase
      str_remove_all("other species - [^;]+") |>
      # Delete all standard labels
      str_remove_all(regex(labels_regex, ignore_case = TRUE)) |>
      # Delete leftover semicolons
      str_remove_all(";") |>
      str_squish() |>
      na_if("")
  )

for (label in standard_labels) {
  col_name <- paste0("notes_", str_replace_all(label, " ", "_"))

  # Check if the label exists in the notes string
  # This returns TRUE if found, FALSE if not
  parsed_data[[col_name]] <- str_detect(
    parsed_data$notes,
    regex(label, ignore_case = TRUE)
  ) |>
    replace_na(FALSE)
}
```

## Data QA/QC
Validated data - ~4hrs of data quality check (i.e., QA/QC)
I corrected some annotations using the previous `102_label_ETF_EPT_images_app.py`

```{r}
#| label: check-data-cols
# Check columns to ensure consistency before removing/aggregating/tidying

# Check odd cases
parsed_data |> count(odd_cases)

# Each obs should be assigned either adult or nymph
table(parsed_data$label_adult, parsed_data$`label_nymph/larva`)
parsed_data |> filter(label_adult == TRUE & `label_nymph/larva` == TRUE)

# All should be no image / copyrighted
table(parsed_data$labeled)
parsed_data |> filter(labeled == FALSE) |> print(n = 500)

# should be 0
table(parsed_data$label_look_into_later)

# Look for obs marked with missing data that aren't also marked as duplicates
table(parsed_data$label_missing_data)
parsed_data |>
  filter(label_missing_data == TRUE & !str_detect(notes, "dupe")) |>
  print(n = 500, width = 500)

# Check if overlap betwen interactions
# Just overlap between fungus & predation, so list fungus first
table(
  parsed_data$notes_predation,
  parsed_data$notes_mating,
  parsed_data$notes_fungus
)

# Should be none
# just has 1 copyright observation
table(parsed_data$`label_can't_id`)
parsed_data |>
  filter(
    `label_can't_id` == TRUE &
      is.na(species_id_corrected) &
      notes_dupe == FALSE &
      notes_unsure == FALSE
  )

# All corrected species should not be "unsure" of the ID
table(parsed_data$notes_unsure, parsed_data$notes_corrected)
parsed_data |> filter(notes_unsure == TRUE & notes_corrected == TRUE)

# All species should be corrected on iNaturalist by me
# (or by others if there's enough support already provided for the proper ID)
table(parsed_data$species_id_corrected, parsed_data$notes_corrected)
parsed_data |> filter(!is.na(species_id_corrected) & notes_corrected == FALSE)

# There should be no jubeniles captured at light traps
table(parsed_data$`label_nymph/larva`, parsed_data$label_light_trap)
parsed_data |> filter(`label_nymph/larva` == TRUE & label_light_trap == TRUE)

# There should be no overlap in collection types
table(parsed_data$`label_net/container`, parsed_data$label_microscope)
table(parsed_data$`label_net/container`, parsed_data$notes_light_trap)
table(parsed_data$`label_net/container`, parsed_data$label_light_trap)
parsed_data |> filter(`label_net/container` == TRUE & label_microscope == TRUE)
table(parsed_data$label_microscope, parsed_data$notes_light_trap)
table(parsed_data$label_microscope, parsed_data$label_light_trap)
parsed_data |> filter(label_microscope == TRUE & label_light_trap == TRUE)

#check for overlap for observations with issus
table(
  parsed_data$notes_no_image,
  parsed_data$notes_dupe,
  parsed_data$notes_unsure
)
```


## Tidy data

```{r}
#| label: tidy-data
tidy_data <- parsed_data |>
  # Fix column names & change for readability
  rename(
    label_juvenile = `label_nymph/larva`,
    label_net_container = `label_net/container`,
    flower_associate = notes_flower,
    fave_image = notes_fave,
    cannot_identify = `label_can't_id`,
    human_present = label_hand,
    preserved_specimen = notes_preserved,
    multiple_specimen_present = label_multiple_specimens,
    inat_id_corrected = notes_corrected,
    duplicate = notes_dupe,
    missing_image = notes_no_image,
    species_id_unsure = notes_unsure
  ) |>

  # Remove processed columns or unneeded metadata
  select(-label_look_into_later, -label_missing_data, -labeled, -notes) |>

  # Aggregate columns
  mutate(
    # Create evidence_type column
    evidence_type = case_when(
      label_adult & label_evidence ~ "nymph to adult exuviae",
      label_juvenile & label_evidence ~ "nymph-related evidence", # nymphal molt or case
      label_evidence ~ "eggs",
      TRUE ~ "organism"
    ),

    # Create life_stage column
    life_stage = case_when(
      label_adult ~ "adult",
      label_juvenile ~ "nymph/larvae",
      (notes_egg | notes_eggs) & label_evidence ~ "eggs",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Create interaction column
    spp_interaction = case_when(
      notes_fungus ~ "fungus parasitism",
      notes_predation ~ "predation",
      notes_mating ~ "reproduction",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Create collection technique column
    collection_technique = case_when(
      label_net_container ~ "in a net/container",
      label_microscope ~ "under microscope",
      label_light_trap | notes_light_trap ~ "from light trap",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # no particular technique
    ),

    # Create observation issues column
    obs_issues = case_when(
      missing_image ~ "missing image",
      duplicate ~ "duplicate image",
      species_id_unsure ~ "unsure of ID",
      notes_copyright ~ "copyrighted image",
      !is.na(species_id_corrected) ~ "incorrect species ID",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # other issue
    )
  ) |>
  # Remove unncessary columns
  select(
    -c(
      label_evidence,
      label_adult,
      label_juvenile,
      notes_fungus,
      notes_predation,
      notes_mating,
      label_net_container,
      label_microscope,
      missing_image,
      duplicate,
      species_id_unsure,
      notes_copyright,
      label_light_trap,
      notes_light_trap,
      notes_egg,
      notes_eggs
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(
    c(
      life_stage,
      evidence_type,
      multiple_specimen_present,
      human_present,
      collection_technique,
      preserved_specimen,
      spp_interaction,
      flower_associate
    ),
    .after = observation_id
  ) |>
  relocate(
    c(
      cannot_identify,
      inat_id_corrected,
      obs_issues,
      species_id_corrected,
    ),
    .after = last_col()
  )

#rm(parsed_data)
```

## Metadata

Description of each column in the `tidy_data` dataset, which is divided into smaller datasets in the [finalize-datasets section](#finalize-datasets).

For `cannot_identify` and `species_id_corrected`, observations were moved to a higher taxon (e.g., Pterygota) if no diagnostic characters of the three EPT orders were present. This was usually caused by low image resolution (far away shot, blurry image), and rarely caused by my uncertainty of the labelled organism

| Column number | Column name | Column description | Values | Column data class | 
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1] | `species` | Insect order | `Ephemeroptera`, `Plecoptera`, or `Trichoptera` | string |
| [2] | `observation_id` | Observation ID number on iNaturalist | eg., `12345` | double |
| [3] | `life_stage` | Life stage of organism contained in observation images | `adult`, `nymph/larvae`, `eggs` | string |
| [4] | `evidence_type` | Type of evidence in image | `nymph to adult exuviae`, `nymph-related evidence`, `NA` [NA = actual organism probably] | string |
| [5] | `multiple_specimen_present` | Multiple specimen of the same insect order of the observation present | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [6] | `human_present` | presence of human skin, hands, fingers, body, etc. in observation image(s) | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [7] | `collection_technique` | Technique used to collect organism in the observation | `in a net/container`, `under microscope`, `from light trap`, `NA` [NA = no techniques observed, may be wild/artificial background] | string |
| [8] | `preserved_specimen` | dead specimen under microscope or in container, may be pinned | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [9] | `spp_interaction` | Species interaction involving the organism in the observation | `fungus parasitism`, `predation`, `reproduction`, `NA` [NA = no interactions observed] | string | 
| [10] | `flower_associate` | Presence of organism on flower(s) | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical |
| [11] | `odd_cases` | Other notes indicating other potentially valuable or interesting information within images | x | string |
| [12] | `fave_image` | Favorite images or observations to use for research communication & visualization purposes | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [13] | `cannot_identify` | could not identify to an EPT order for some reason described column `obs_issues` | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [14] | `inat_id_corrected` | ID corrected/updated on iNaturalist | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [15] | `obs_issues` | reason for an image not being annotated or being unable to annotate | `missing image` (no image was downloaded due to CC rights (see 101_get_EPT_images.qmd for more info)), `duplicate image` (observation image is visually duplicate to another observation), `unsure of ID` (unsure whether observation is EPT due to image resolution or lack of diagnostic characters), `copyrighted image` (image has copyright issues identified by me), `incorrect species ID` (species identification is incorrect), `NA` [NA = no issues with observation] | string | 
| [16] | `species_id_corrected` | the corrected identification of the organism in the image | e.g., `Pterygota` | string | 



## Finalize datasets

```{r}
#| label: make-final-dataset
final_data <- tidy_data |>
  filter(cannot_identify == FALSE & is.na(obs_issues)) |>
  select(-cannot_identify:-species_id_corrected)
```

```{r}
#| label: make-reject-dataset
reject_data <- tidy_data |>
  filter(cannot_identify == TRUE | !is.na(obs_issues)) |>
  # These records were NOT annotated with information,
  # since I assumed I wouldn't use them for analyses.
  # I removed the empty annotation-related columns
  select(species, observation_id, odd_cases:species_id_corrected)
```

```{r}
#| label: make-fave-dataset
fave_data <- tidy_data |>
  filter(fave_image == TRUE | str_detect(odd_cases, "Turtle"))
```

```{r}
#| label: save-data
export_list <- list(
  "103a_ETF_EPT_final_annotated.rds" = final_data,
  "103b_ETF_EPT_reject_annotated.rds" = reject_data,
  "103c_ETF_EPT_fave_annotated.rds" = final_data
)

iwalk(export_list, ~ write_rds(.x, file = here(L1_data_dir, .y)))
```
